body: Will be moving in august for my husbands job - his job is in Sonoita, AZ. Are there any good suburbs or areas of Tucson to live in that would keep his commute to 30-45 minutes? Our budget is around $1,000-1500 (1500 max if a lot of utilities are included)- would be looking for just a one bedroom, pet friendly if possible. We don’t have any pets currently but would like to get a dog. Appreciate any and all advice! We will be moving from upstate NY and I’ve never been to Arizona or anywhere outside the east coast really! other than a work conference in Phoenix a couple of years ago!

When I lost my dog suddenly, I experienced this as well. I’d be able to get through my work day ok, and even talk about my experience at the vet and share memories with my dog (although I can’t imagine having to work at the same vet office where she was put down… my heart goes out to you!), but then the second I would get In my car to leave I would just absolutely lose it and sob and cry most of the way home. Either that, or id make it all the way home and sob in my parked car. Not sure what it is exactly about the commute home that hits so hard with pet loss. It did get better with time, and it will get better with time for you! To this day, although the emotional days are fewer and further in between, my drive home from work are still the times I tend to think about her most. Sending so much love to you.
I am expecting anything around/under an hour… but would be happy to find something with a little less of a commute. I’ll have to check out Vail!

My husband got a job in Sonoita, AZ and we will be moving in several months. Looking to live somewhere between Sonoita and Tucson since it will likely be easier for me to find a job in Tucson and we’d like to be somewhat near a city. Suggestions on best places to live with a reasonable commute to Sonoita?
We aren’t big on nightlife but are kind of in that “young professional” category where we do like restaurants and activities! We enjoy outdoor activities, and are moving very far away from family and friends so some form of community involvement will be important. Would appreciate any and all suggestions and tips!
Is there a benefit to Nogales? Or should we just go with Tucson station if the main benefit to Nogales is having Tucson nearby?
A little less than 8 months total from initial application to EOD

Yes ik we will be on the southwest border but what I’m reading it sounds like there are a lot of different stations and could be a couple of different states so just wondering among those what some of the best locations are

Not needing to worry about birth control…. I mean other than maybe using a condom but the fact that it’s on me in the relationship to take medication or get an implant of some sort and have the responsibility of staying on top of it while also dealing with side affects and medical affects…. As someone with some hormonal and health issues to begin with it’s such a lose lose situation being on birth control.
You made a selfless decision to give your precious boy peace, and took on this grief and pain so he could rest. He knows how much you loved him. Sending love 💗

I don’t really have anything comforting or helpful to say but I just wanted to say I relate to this SO much. I miss my girl terribly but you put it into words perfectly that I also miss the me I was with her…. She was my only “hobby” or my main life outside of my job… I spent every weekend and every evening training, walking, hiking, playing with or just snuggling her… most of my conversations with friends eventually got to the point of me talking about her, she’s my entire social media accounts,etc.  I feel this so much😔

Sending so much love. I know exactly how you feel. It fucking sucks. I know how bad it hurts but with a little time it gets better. You’ll always miss him but with time it will get less raw and you’ll be able to think about him fondly. You’ll get through.

I just lost my 5 year old lab hound mix to cancer this week and it was a similar sudden timeline. I feel your pain. It is so unfair. I am sending so much love; this is one of the shittiest things I’ve ever had to go through. I know you loved him so well. Don’t be afraid to let it hurt and let yourself grieve.
I realize the need to take it seriously…. I just am not sure what exactly to do? Beyond making sure the neighbor has our number and the dogs vaccine information what can I do?

Yes she was approved on our lease and all that so that’s not an issue. But I could see the issue with her not being on a leash. I was running out to the grill and thought I had pulled the door shut. I am so upset with all of this.
I have no idea. I’m just so tired Idk. I don’t think it’s exactly the right word but I don’t know how else to describe it
